kod_metni:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from evds import evdsAPI

evds = evdsAPI('xxxxxxxx')

%matplotlib inline
%config InlineBackend.figure_format = 'retina'
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [2.75, 2.25]
plt.rcParams['figure.dpi'] = 300

df = evds.get_data(['TP.TRY.MT02'],
                   startdate="27-01-2021", enddate="10-03-2024"
                   )

df['Tarih'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Tarih'],dayfirst=True)
df = df.set_index('Tarih')

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()
y = df["TP_TRY_MT02"]
plt.plot(y, color="k", label = "TL 3 Aya Kadar Mevduat Faizi - %")
plt.plot(y.tail(1), marker="o",color="r",markersize=1.5)

plt.xticks(rotation=45, fontsize=7)
plt.yticks( fontsize=7)


plt.gca().xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m'))
plt.gca().xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=4))

ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_color('#C0C0C0')

plt.legend(prop={'size': 7})
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--')

#plt.ylim(15,30)
fig.tight_layout()  # otherwise the right y-label is slightly clipped

plt.savefig('TL_Mevduat_3Ay_Faizi.png', dpi=300)

excel_filename = "3Ay_Faizi.xlsx"
df.to_excel(excel_filename)
